c.v: Eight out of the 256 peripheral outputs (index: 93 ~ 100 in Table 6.11-1) support
By default output is enabled for these eight channels.
This Sigma Delta modulator can also output PDM (pulse density modulation) signal with configurable duty cycle.
E(z) is quantization error and X(z) is the input.
This modulator supports scaling down of APB_CLK by divider 1 ~ 256:
After scaling, the clock cycle is equal to one pulse output cycle from the modulator.
_IN is a signed number with a range of [-128, 127] and is used to control the duty cycle (see the note below) of PDM output signal.
_IN = -128, the duty cycle of the output signal is
_IN = 0, the duty cycle of the output signal is near
_IN = 127, the duty cycle of the output signal is close to
